name: search
title: Search
offline_items: Cold launch in airplane mode → Search shows cached data
Cached data shows a 'last updated' time or stale indicator
Network lost while on Search → data stays visible (no blank screen or crash)
Clear offline message or banner shown
Auto-refresh on reconnect (no manual pull needed)
No forced re-login or PIN after reconnect
stock quote page opens offline from cache
Cached values are clearly not presented as live prices
No crash or ANR during offline ↔ online transitions
notes: Search entry is on the Home screen of every app (search textbox or icon); tapping it opens the Search screen. Flow per run: type the query -> clear the text -> back. Developer confirmed screens on 2026-10-23. test_subjects RELIANCE and INFY are the agent's default (liquid NIFTY stocks every app can find); change if needed. auto_open steps verified on all installed apps except Groww on 2026-10-23 (Kite needs a second tap on the field of its search screen; Kotak Neo needs the All chip after typing because the Home tab preselects a segment). RISE, Kite and Kotak Neo show a device biometric prompt on every cold start: the developer must approve it; drive.py waits.

auto_open._note: Fixed taps on each app's Home search box/icon (Galaxy A37 screenshots, 2026-10-23); most of these homes animate live prices so uiautomator dump never idles and find: cannot be used. Groww steps unverified: app was signed out.
